prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: a single sprite atlas for an educational free-practice interface. Generate a clean, uniform 4-column by 2-row grid of eight isolated soft polished 3D icons, absolutely no text or labels. Equal square cells, each icon centered in its own cell with generous transparent padding, equal visual sizes, no overlaps between cells. Top row from left to right: an emerald-green magnifying glass, a waving royal-blue flag on a warm wooden short pole, a lavender document with a purple magnifying glass, a golden lightbulb. Bottom row from left to right: a fresh green seedling with two leaves, an open blue book, a purple ascending three-bar chart, a warm amber professional briefcase. Friendly smooth plastic, subtle dimensional highlights, softly rounded bevels, professional educational visual style, crisp silhouettes. Genuine transparent alpha background, no white backgrounds, no backdrop, no circular discs, no glow blobs, no borders, no frames, no letters, no words, no extra objects. The atlas must be a wide image with aspect ratio 2:1 and its eight cells laid out precisely in 4 columns and 2 rows. This atlas is one cohesive final web sprite asset.
implementation: Shared interactive HTML controls; the reference is not displayed as an inert screenshot.
difficulty: Levels 1-3 select existing curricular difficulty banks. Level 4 reuses advanced items with autonomous initial support. Numeric laboratories retain their original values and rules.
accessibility: Native radio selection, keyboard focus, high contrast, larger text, simplified visuals, and Nubi as the only accessibility entry.
responsive: Three modality columns and four level columns on wide desktop; stacked modalities and two level columns on tablet; one column with a separate Nubi dock on mobile.
